The Router was not too lenient; it appropriately flagged the limitations of the visual data.

The 'perspective_distortion' in background fish (severity 1.0) is minor and expected in underwater photography/AI generation of non-focus elements. I do not see evidence of severe melting or fusion beyond the tail tip. The severity ratings are appropriate; the artifacts are present but do not compromise the overall structural integrity of the main subject.
